Interactive extraction app

Source: R/shiny_extract.R
df_shiny_extract.Rd

Pick an included study, run the LLM on its full text, review and correct the extracted JSON with live schema validation, save it, and import it into the metawoRld project.

Usage

df_shiny_extract(
  metawoRld_path = ".",
  chat = NULL,
  fulltext_dir = NULL,
  launch.browser = TRUE
)

Arguments

metawoRld_path

Project root.

chat

Optional ellmer chat object. If NULL, a "provider/model" string can be entered in the app.

fulltext_dir

Optional folder with full texts named after the identifiers (see df_find_fulltexts()).

launch.browser

Passed to shiny::runApp().

Value

Runs the app.
